svg.title: One DorkOS program in three roles today, with planned parts dashed, and the seams between them
svg.desc: The accepted direction of ADR 261015-042933 as of 2026-11-21. One server package runs as a person's computer, a hub or an agent computer, and ships the space server as a fourth entry. Solid boxes exist in the source at this review, including the ones that are off by default; dashed boxes are planned. Servers connect by pairing. A computer's chats reach the web through the chat relay. The hub role, the agent-computer role and the relay are built but gated or off by default; the hub image has booted only in CI. Nothing here is deployment proof.
